$description: Shared world-role meanings, read before each world binding. This source defines no values; world and neutral files retain the reasons for their own choices. Bounds are stated only where the retained role or design guidance supplies them. Other numeric limits remain unspecified.

critical.$description: Critical state: error, destructive and failed outcomes as text, icon and boundary on paper and sheet; always paired with a label or shape. Warning, success and complete have no colour role; text and shape carry them. A running or pending process is held state and emits color.signal.

paper.$description: The world's page surface: its stock.

sheet.$description: A lighter or raised stock for figure beds and cards.

muted.$description: Secondary text within the ink floors.

accent.$description: Links, focus-adjacent emphasis and small marks; never state.

signal.$description: Emission: light held by state. The world illumination emission aliases this role, so each mode has one emission hue.

key.$description: The key light's colour in this mode: daylight in light, the room's lamp in dark, each world's own.

sheet.$description: A lighter or raised stock for figure beds and cards.

muted.$description: Secondary text within the ink floors.

accent.$description: Links, focus-adjacent emphasis and small marks; never state.

size.$description: The terminal Home identity scale in a wide composition.

family.$description: Display face for the world; reading and system families remain shared roles.

width.$description: Width-axis coordinate of the display face. A face without a width axis leaves this value without effect; the available range belongs to the selected face.

family.$description: Face for figures and numeric labels in the world.

case.$description: System-label case (text-transform). Literal source identifiers retain their case; the pattern names the case treatment.

key.$description: Key light colour: the mode-resolved key role, so the world's key follows the page's mode.

key-angle.$description: Direction of the key light in degrees.

emission.$description: Emission hue: the mode-resolved signal role, so emission and held state are one hue in each mode.

emission-strength.$description: Strength of the light held by state.

emission-spread.$description: Spread of the light around the element that holds state.

fill.$description: Ground share of the functional optical plane.

edge.$description: Reflected contour of the functional optical plane.

highlight.$description: Contact reflection of the functional optical plane.

blur.$description: Backdrop diffusion through the functional optical plane.

saturation.$description: Chroma retained through the functional optical plane.

scene-fill.$description: Transmitted scene share of the functional optical plane.

radius.$description: Outer curvature of the functional optical plane.

emulsion.$description: Emulsion bed of imagery or an expressive field.

raster.$description: Material texture pattern. Texture belongs to its named fields and must leave running text legible.

pitch.$description: Spacing of the material texture pattern.

opacity.$description: Opacity of the material texture pattern.

interval.$description: Space between successive figures in the flow.

caption.$description: Caption and qualification placement relative to its figure (pattern: below, above, beside, margin or row).

gap.$description: Distance between a figure and its caption.

scale-step.$description: Scale step of a figure and its qualification; the two share this step.

planes.$description: Number of optical planes the world composes (1 is a single flat plane).

blur.$description: Softness of the cast between planes; 0 is a hard edge.

depth.$description: Optical depth of interface and reading planes; authored scene geography remains independent.

expressive-spring.$description: Expressive spring for Motion consumers; the build also emits it as a CSS linear() easing with its duration.

reduced.$description: The world's expressive motion without travel: its time carried by light, opacity and tone. The reduced easing stands in for the expressive easing and spring.

expressive-scale.$description: Relative expressive pace without travel. Multiplies motion.reduced.expressive.

expressive-easing.$description: Expressive easing without travel, carrying the intended state through light, opacity and tone.
Expressive easing curve for the world.

geometry.$description: Shape language of boundaries, marks and structure. Shared control semantics and learned responses remain intact.

plate-edge.$description: The world-specific edge treatment of a plate.

size.$description: Size of the plate-edge treatment, interpreted by its named pattern.

bleed.$description: Bleed permission on the scale contained (0) · peak-only (1) · named-plates (2) · free (3); it narrows what amplitude level 4 permits, never widens it. Never crop away information the image carries.

default.$description: Fresh-visit colour-mode policy: system follows the device; dark starts in the designed dark mode. Explicit mode choices remain available.
